in_sanskrit.name: Nischay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Decision, resolution, firmness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nischay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Nischay is derived from the Sanskrit word निश्चय (niścaya) which means 'decision', 'resolution', or 'firmness'. In Hindu mythology, Nischay is associated with Lord Shiva, symbolizing his unwavering commitment and determination. This name is believed to instill courage and wisdom, as well as a strong sense of conviction and purpose in the bearer.
